notes.title: Beta Complete!
notes.notes: Sign up for the beta test is now closed, current testers will still be able to play the game through the weekend. Thank you to everyone who participated!

notes.title: Open Beta Now Live
notes.notes:
Want to play an early build of the game? Now you can!

Starting today there is an open beta on Windows and Linux. This is the full version of the game, not an abbreviated demo, so consider this a spoiler alert if you'd rather wait for the release version.

If you do choose to play the beta, you can leave feedback here:

https://forms.gle/N4j9TScKiD3vU2K78

Thanks for taking a look!
